On canvas load, the new useRestoreVideoGenerations hook detects mid-generation videos, checks their current status via the API, and either updates them with completed results or resumes polling until they finish. Add !object.isGenerating to showTransformer to prevent resize during generation. Fixes TSK-4218 * feat(canvas): add end frame validation and UI marking for I2V video models Models with supportsEndFrame now show a "Start/End Frame" badge in the model selector, display an end frame upload area when selected, and block submission until an end frame image is provided. Switching to a model without end frame support automatically clears the end frame state. * fix(canvas): resolve TypeScript type errors in video-info and restore hook - Cast spread result to VideoObject in updateObject to fix union type widening - Add 'Changed Video Property' to HistoryAction union type - Fix pushHistory call in video-info to pass HistoryAction object instead of string * chore(scripts): add video model investigation scripts - investigate-video-models.ts: DB analysis of generation success/failure rates per model endpoint (requires .env.development.local) - verify-video-endpoints.ts: FAL OpenAPI schema verification for all 21 video models (no DB required) Part of TSK-4222 video model success rate investigation. * fix(canvas): restore video placeholder rendering after save-load round trip After saving a canvas, video objects have their `src` stripped. On reload, generating placeholders (without videoId) were not getting `src` restored, leaving it as `undefined`. `isVideoPlaceholder` checked `obj.src === ''` which returned false for `undefined`, causing the placeholder to render as a broken VideoNode instead of a VideoPlaceholderNode with the loading animation. Fixes: - `isVideoPlaceholder`: use falsy check (`!obj.src`) instead of strict empty string comparison - `loadFromCanvasDraft`: ensure all video objects without a valid src get `src: ''` restored, maintaining the placeholder contract * fix(canvas): decouple video polling from UI component lifecycle Move video generation polling from useCanvasVideoGeneration (component-level) to useRestoreVideoGenerations (page-level persistent hook). Bug: FloatingQuickActions returns null when image is deselected, unmounting FloatingVideoGenerateContainer mid-generation. This cleared the polling timer, so onComplete never fired and placeholders stayed in isGenerating:true forever. Fix: useCanvasVideoGeneration now only handles the initial API submission. useRestoreVideoGenerations runs a watchdog interval that detects generating videos not currently polled and picks them up. This also removes duplicate onComplete/onError callbacks from all three video containers (I2V, T2V, FLF). * fix(canvas): update imageToVideoRequest status to COMPLETED on success getRequestResult() created Video + VideoRequestOutput records on success but never updated imageToVideoRequest.status to COMPLETED. Only the failure path set FAILED. This meant the DB cache path never activated, causing every poll to re-download, re-upload, and re-create Video records. * fix(canvas): persist restored video state immediately after polling completes The restore hook (useRestoreVideoGenerations) already committed state changes to history after polling completed (added in Bug A fix), but relied on the debounced auto-save (3s delay) to persist to the database. If the user navigated away before the debounce fired, the restored video state was lost, causing a loop where every visit restarted polling. Fix: call saveImmediately() after each commitObject() in the polling completion paths (completed, failed, timeout, network error). Uses a ref to avoid destabilizing the useCallback dependency array. * fix(canvas): persist video generation state immediately and guard navigation When video generation starts, generationRequestId was only stored in Zustand (memory). The debounced auto-save (3s/10s maxWait) could miss persisting it if the user refreshed before the debounce fired. Fix A: Call saveImmediately() right after writing generationRequestId to the store in all three video generation flows (I2V, T2V, FLF). Fix B: Add beforeunload navigation guard that warns the user when videos are still generating, preventing accidental data loss. * fix(canvas): use title as React key in ShortcutDialog to fix missing key warning The importImage tool has no hotKey, causing item.key to be undefined and triggering a React "missing unique key" warning. Use item.title instead, which is always defined and unique within each category. * fix(canvas): resolve saveImmediately race condition with debounced auto-save When FLF/I2V video generation commits a placeholder to history, the debounced auto-save (3s) fires before startGeneration() returns. This persists the placeholder WITHOUT generationRequestId. When the API finally returns and saveImmediately() is called, the mutationFn reads a stale isSaving=true from the render-time closure and silently skips, leaving generationRequestId unpersisted. On refresh, the restore hook cannot resume polling. Fix: - Read isSaving from useCanvasStore.getState() instead of closure - saveImmediately now cancels pending debounced saves and waits for any in-progress save before proceeding T2V was unaffected because it does not call commitTempCanvasObjects inside handleGenerate, so no debounced save races with saveImmediately. * feat(canvas): support selecting end frame from image generation history Allow users to pick an end frame image from their generation history (ImageSelectionDialog) in addition to local file upload for I2V models that support end frame. API already supports endFrameImageId — this change is UI-only. TSK-4248 * fix(canvas): use rawUrl for end frame gallery preview image The preview image was broken because `output.image.url` is a proxy/CDN path that doesn't render in a plain tag. Other components (image-selection-dialog, inpainting) use `rawUrl` which is the direct S3 URL that works with . * fix(canvas): use HistoryAction type for commitObject to fix build type error The commitObject callback parameter was typed as `string` but commitTempCanvasObjects expects HistoryAction with a strict union type, causing TypeScript compilation to fail during Vercel deployment. * feat(canvas): add T2V/I2V mode switching to video placeholder panel Add tab-based mode switching to FloatingTextToVideoContainer so users can choose between Text-to-Video and Image-to-Video generation from the same video placeholder. I2V mode includes start frame selection (local upload or generation history), end frame support for compatible models, and proper generate button validation. * feat(canvas): integrate video upload into toolbar import button with hover popover Move video upload from VideoPlaceholderNode's upload icon to the toolbar's importImage button. Hovering the button shows a Popover with "Upload Image" and "Upload Video" options. Upload Image opens MultiStepImageSelector; Upload Video triggers a Zustand store signal that gazai-canvas listens to, opening the file picker and placing the video at viewport center. - Add useVideoUploadStore (counter-based trigger pattern) - Replace importImage toolbar button with hover Popover - Subscribe to upload trigger in gazai-canvas via useEffect - Remove upload icon, hover state, and click handler from VideoPlaceholderNode - Add i18n keys (en, ja, zh-TW, zh-CN) for uploadImage/uploadVideo - Update tests: new toolbar-upload-popover tests, simplified click-guard tests * style(canvas): use HighlightTabs for T2V/I2V mode switcher Replace shadcn Tabs with HighlightTabs component to match the highlighter underline style used elsewhere in the app. * feat(canvas): add video selection from history in toolbar import popover Add third option "Select from History" to the toolbar import popover, allowing users to pick videos from their generation history and place them directly on the canvas without re-uploading. New components: - VideoSelectionDialog: dialog with gallery grid + confirm/cancel - VideoGenerationGallery: infinite-scroll video history with search - HighlightTabs: missing UI component (fixes pre-existing build error) Modified: - Toolbar: third popover button + handleVideoFromHistorySelected handler - i18n: added translations for en/ja/zh-TW/zh-CN TSK-4268 * fix(ui): replace HighlightTabs with correct highlighter underline implementation The previous version was a basic shadcn Tabs copy with bg-muted pill style. Replace with the proper yellow highlighter underline animation component that uses animate-highlighter-extend. * style(canvas): center T2V/I2V highlight tabs * style(canvas): evenly distribute T2V/I2V tabs across full width * style(canvas): align start frame label with highlight tab text * fix(canvas): floating toolbar follows selected placeholder & per-object isGenerating TSK-4326: Sync selection → t2vPlaceholderId so FloatingTextToVideoContainer moves to whichever placeholder the user clicks. Previously it only tracked the last-created placeholder. Also resets form state on placeholder switch. TSK-4327: Change isGenerating source from hook-level generationStatus to per-object VideoObject.isGenerating. Rename to reflect its actual trigger (video placeholder on canvas). All three floating containers (VideoPlaceholder, ImageToVideo, FLF) now pass compact to DynamicFormFields, ensuring consistent UI when switching between models with and without inputSchema. * fix(canvas): use effectiveType in Select parseValue and unify prompt maxLength - DynamicFormFields: non-compact Select path incorrectly used property.type (could be undefined for anyOf unions) instead of effectiveType - Add maxLength={1000} to FloatingImageToVideoContainer and FloatingFLFVideoContainer prompt Textarea to match VideoPlaceholder * fix(canvas): move "select from history" to video upload submenu Restructure the upload popover from a flat 3-option menu to a 2-level menu: first level shows "Upload Image" and "Upload Video", hovering "Upload Video" reveals a submenu with "Upload Video" and "Select from History". Includes 150ms close delay for smooth diagonal mouse movement. * fix(test): align posterUrl fallback in video-selection-dialog test with component The component uses rawUrl ?? url ?? null (3-level fallback) but the test only used rawUrl ?? null. Added url fallback and a test case for when rawUrl is missing but url exists. * feat(canvas): add auto snap/align for object drag and resize Add snapping behavior when dragging or resizing canvas objects near other objects' edges or centers. Visual guide lines appear during snap and disappear on release. Alt/Option key temporarily disables snapping. New files: - utils/canvas/snap-utils.ts — pure snap algorithm (getSnapLines, findClosestSnap) - components/canvas/konva/guide-lines-layer.tsx — Konva Layer for guide lines - tests/unit/utils/canvas/snap-utils.test.ts — unit tests with 50+ object perf test Modified: - constants/canvas.ts — SNAP_THRESHOLD, GUIDE_LINE_COLOR constants - components/canvas/types.ts — GuideLine, SnapLine, SnapResult, SnapBounds types - store/canvas-store.ts — activeGuideLines state - store/canvas-modifier-key.ts — isAltKeyPressed state - hooks/use-canvas-key-events.tsx — Alt key down/up tracking - hooks/use-canvas-image-events.ts — snap in image/video drag + resize - hooks/use-canvas-text-v2-events.ts — snap in TextV2 drag - components/canvas/gazai-canvas.tsx — snap in frame/panel drag, mount GuideLinesLayer * fix(canvas): add page edge and center snap lines to getSnapLines getSnapLines() only snapped to other canvas objects. Now accepts optional pageDimensions parameter to include page boundary lines (left/center/right edges and top/center/bottom edges), enabling objects to snap to the canvas page itself. * fix(canvas): apply snap offset to node position during resize handleImageTransformMove() calculated snap offsets but only used them for guide line rendering. Now the offset is also applied to the node position via node.position(), matching handleImageDragMove() behavior. * fix(canvas): add drag snap to Shape and Tone objects Shape and Tone objects previously moved freely without snap alignment. Added handleShapeDragMove and handleToneDragMove with the same snap pattern used by images — snapping to other objects and page boundaries, with Alt key to disable. Guide lines are cleared on drag end. * fix(test): correct ToneType in shape-tone-snap test * fix(canvas): remove focus ring on video gallery search input The search Input in VideoSelectionDialog had an abnormal thick black border caused by ring + ring-offset + border stacking. Add focus-visible:ring-0 and focus-visible:ring-offset-0 to suppress the default shadcn/ui Input ring styles. * fix(canvas): dismiss floating video panel on deselection The floating video placeholder panel stayed visible after clicking away because the selection-sync effect only set videoPlaceholderId on match but never cleared it on mismatch. * fix(canvas): add video object support to rubber-band selection Video objects were missing from getObjectsInSelectionRect type-checking chain, preventing them from being selected via rubber-band drag. - Extract getObjectsInSelectionRect as pure function for testability - Add isVideoObject branch to selection logic - Add 8 unit tests covering video selection, mixed groups, edge cases * fix(canvas): remove undefined canAddObject reference in toolbar Remove dead guard code referencing undeclared canAddObject and openLimitDialog variables that caused a runtime ReferenceError. Object limits were removed in b23a94ccb, making this guard unreachable anyway. * fix(canvas): address PR #1454 review — security, error handling, and performance - Fix dynamicParams spread order in fal.ts to prevent prompt injection - Clean up orphaned placeholders when startGeneration fails (3 containers) - Capture error in polling catch block with structured logging - Wrap refundToken in try-catch to preserve original error on refund failure - Replace console.error with logger.error in video API routes for Sentry - Add toast notification on saveImmediately failure - Optimize Zustand selector in video navigation guard to avoid re-renders - Add commitTempCanvasObjects for generating state in placeholder container - Add error logging to getImageDataUrl catch blocks * fix(canvas): await saveImmediately with timeout to prevent hangs and unhandled rejections * fix(canvas): add polling retry logic with backoff and structured error logging - Add retry counter (max 3) with exponential backoff (2s, 4s, 8s) before deleting video placeholder on network error, preventing transient WiFi hiccups from destroying in-progress generations - Replace console.error with structured logger (createLogger) that reports to Sentry via VIDEO_POLL_NETWORK_ERROR error ID - Add Sentry logging with VIDEO_POLL_TIMEOUT error ID when 10-minute polling timeout fires, including objectId, elapsed time, and requestId * fix(canvas): clear isDirty after save and fix toolbar dark mode - Call clearIsDirty() in saveCanvas onSuccess callback so the dirty flag resets after a successful save - Replace hardcoded bg-white with bg-background on the video submenu so it respects dark mode theming * fix(canvas): consolidate save timeout into single promise and fix retry count - Replace Promise.race with single promise to prevent leaked Zustand subscription on timeout and unhandled rejection - Change MAX_POLL_RETRIES to 4 so 3 actual retries occur (2s, 4s, 8s) --------- Co-authored-by: Kaipo Chen
